title: Sort colours into matching tubes
description: Pour liquid only when the top colour matches and the destination tube has enough space. Complete each tube with one colour.

title: Progress through puzzle levels
description: Start with clear, simple boards and face more involved colour arrangements as the puzzle progresses.

title: Use Undo and Reset thoughtfully
description: Undo a move to reconsider your sequence, or reset the board when you want to rethink the puzzle from the beginning.

title: Earn stars and coins as you play
description: Complete levels and build your in-game progress with the reward flow shown in the game.

title: Personalize tubes and backgrounds
description: Explore the in-game shop for cosmetic tube skins and background options that change the look of your puzzle.
